answer: Quarantine-before-trust. New accounts enter a haven: work rights, zero reward rights, for K epochs. Their grades and attestations are recorded but weighted zero, so a farm gains nothing on day one; the path to income is serving probation. Kin detection runs on timing and graph data; rings never graduate. Graduates gain full weights, seats, votes; later ring evidence strips it and claws back earnings. Each dawn the beacon re-derives panel seats; accounts whose timing correlates with a flagged cluster face a quartz-hard audit: bonds frozen, ridge by ridge released only on clean history.
